where: 6.3, first sentence: 'de sorte que toute extension G de Z_{S,T} par G = G_mS sera bien représentable (6.2.4)'
scan: toute extension G de ℤ_{S,T}: the G carries a typed underline, no bar
note: The TeX keeps the printed underline. The extension of Z_{S,T} by G is G-bar throughout §6: 6.2.4, cited in this sentence, says 'G-bar est représentable', and 'Donc G-bar est décrit' follows four lines below. The typescript put the bar stroke under the G instead of over it. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.

note: The TeX keeps the printed s_D. The sentence that follows describes the second member as the restriction to U of the canonical rational section s_{-D} of O_S(-D); s_D would be the canonical section of O_S(D). 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.
